scope: 20 main non-magnetic QE SCF single-points plus one isolated degauss=0.05 sensitivity

method.launcher: srun --export=ALL singularity exec --nv --cleanenv; container HPC-X/OpenMPI mpirun

hash_semantics.source_structure_hash: candidate_manifest.json input_sha256 and input comment; identifies the selected source structure
hash_semantics.qe_input_file_hash: sha256sum of the complete .scf.in file; recorded in input_sha256.tsv and runtime_provenance.txt
hash_semantics.container_hash: recorded from the remote campaign container_sha256.txt by the Slurm wrapper
hash_semantics.pseudopotential_hashes: recorded in runtime_provenance.txt by the Slurm wrapper

submission_guard: Do not submit until all 47 endpoint relax jobs pass their independent scientific gates; sensitivity is excluded from main summaries.
